statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability contributing to these events.
This diagnostic monitoring is critical to assess the etiology of the syncope and cerebral hypoperfusion associated with diagnosis R55.
Diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9 were submitted.
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered.
